hits.title: Creality debuts SPARKX i7 and AI tools at CES 2026 - Engineering.com
hits.snippet: Creality also introduced the SPARKX i7 at CES and announced its launch. The desktop printer features updated lighting and an out-of-box, ready-to-use setup intended to simplify the printing process for general users. SPARKX i7 includes a quick-swap hotend intended to simplify maintenance, a redesigned color-changing mechanism and a four-color filament system intended to reduce material waste. It also includes AI-based features for model generation, printing assistance and real-time mobile control. After its CES appearance, pre-orders have opened in North America, with broader availability planned globally. [...] Alongside SPARKX i7, Creality showcased other products in its desktop ecosystem spanning 3D printing, laser engraving, 3D scanning and AI-based creation tools. These included the Ender-3 V4 3D printer, the Falcon T1 laser engraver, the Sermoon P1 3D scanner with blue-laser scanning and Wi-Fi 7 connectivity, and CubeMe, a Creality Cloud feature that generates a customized 3D model from a single photo. Operating at 10,000 mm/s galvo speed with 0.001 mm precision and carrying a Class 1 safety rating.
